title: the Arthurian mythos
audit_comment: THE ARTHURIAN MYTHOS - the D&DG walk round three, print pp. 17-21: the chivalry doctrine, the two knight templates (the average knight of renown and the knight of quality), the two printed knight rosters (90 good or neutral, 13 evil, 29 of quality - the names ride the data file doc/data/ddg_arthurian_knights.txt), and thirteen named beings from King Arthur to Sir Tristram of Lyonesse. Zero registry defs touched; the floor holds at 995. The flagged eyeball cells: the Gawaine hit points (the 112 of the second-print extract against the 172 of the archive.org 1st print), the Merlin single attack (the IA 17 a djvu artifact), the Garlon height (garbled in both voices) and the Pellinore 6-foot-4 single-voice size.

banner.title: the Arthurian mythos - the D&DG walk round three, print pp. 17-21: the knights of the Round Table - the chivalry doctrine, the two knight templates, the two printed rosters, and thirteen named beings from King Arthur to Sir Tristram.
banner.provenance: primary ink: the extract/ddg tesseract pass (commit cd645b4, pNNN_full.txt + pNNN_tsv.tsv, print = pdf - 1, pages 018-022; the second printing); the collation voice: the archive.org 1st-print derivative (djvu.txt + djvu.xml word geometry). The adjudications: Garlon hit points 80 and one attack (the IA xml words, clean, against the Termux fold), the Arthur 14th level paladin fighter line (the IA voice; the Termux extract dropped the line), the Gawaine Neutral alignment (the 107px geometry match), the Morgan 5 feet 4 inches and Palomides 5 and a half feet sizes (both voices), the Merlin psionic 300 point score with the B C E over All modes (both voices), and the evil-roster Damas and King Mark entries (the IA voice; the Termux two-column interleave dropped them). The Gawaine hit points pin the second-print extract 112 against the 1st-print 172 - flagged for the physical-copy eyeball.
banner.sentinel: the 0 sentinels: ACAlt 0 = a single printed armor class (the two templates read the printed 3 to -2 range); MoveAlt 0 = a single printed move; AtD 0 = a single printed attacks figure; the magic resistance 0 = the printed Standard (all fifteen); the size 0 = the unresolved or ranged cell (the renown template 5-foot-4-to-6 range, the Garlon garble); the class-grid 0 = Nil or none printed; the ability-grid template rows are all 0 (the printed Specials ride the consts); the psi 0 = Nil (Merlin carries the printed 300); the roster flags 0 = the doctrine does not apply; the LawfulPct 0 = a fixed alignment.

bools.name: dgcMaloryCollected
bools.comment: Sir Thomas Malory's Le Morte D'Arthur collected the legends of Arthur and his Knights of the Round Table

bools.name: dgcKnightsRepresentChivalry
bools.comment: Arthur's knights represent the concept of chivalry to modern readers more than any other group

bools.name: dgcChivalryIsFairPlay
bools.comment: chivalrous conduct basically means playing fair

bools.name: dgcMisfortuneDishonorable
bools.comment: taking advantage of an opponent's misfortune is dishonorable

bools.name: dgcBetterOddsDishonorable
bools.comment: fighting at better-than-even odds is dishonorable

bools.name: dgcRespectsLadiesAndClerics
bools.comment: a chivalrous knight shows respect to ladies and good clerics

bools.name: dgcSuspiciousOfSorcery
bools.comment: a chivalrous knight is suspicious of sorcery and will avoid it if possible

bools.name: dgcQuestsWithOaths
bools.comment: knights undertake quests to win fame and prove virtue, swearing oaths of unceasing effort

bools.name: dgcRoundTableOptional
bools.comment: the knights of the Round Table may not fit into some AD&D worlds - the trip to Arthur's Britain is a DM spice option

bools.name: dgcCamelotBoardgameReference
bools.comment: more useful information can be found in TSR's KNIGHTS OF CAMELOT Fantasy Boardgame

bools.name: dgcKnightsHaveWarhorse
bools.comment: knights always have a high quality heavy war-horse

bools.name: dgcKnightWeaponList
bools.comment: knights use a lance, a bastard sword, a two-handed sword, or a morningstar in battle

bools.name: dgcKnightsHaveLesserBeast
bools.comment: knights always have a lesser beast to ride when not fighting

bools.name: dgcKnightsHaveSquire
bools.comment: knights always have a squire of some type to aid them with their equipment

bools.name: dgcSquiresRestrained
bools.comment: squires cannot use swords in battle nor fight from horseback until they have been made knights

bools.name: dgcAverageKnightsKill
bools.comment: average knights will most often kill their defeated opponents, rather than grant mercy

bools.name: dgcQualityKnightsMerciful
bools.comment: the knights of quality usually grant mercy (the 75 percent doctrine rides the consts)

bools.name: dgcArthurPaladin
bools.comment: the printed FIGHTER line: 14th level paladin (the IA voice; the Termux extract dropped the line)

bools.name: dgcArthurSwordFromStone
bools.comment: Arthur pulled the sword from the stone and identified himself as rightful king of all England

bools.name: dgcArthurUtherMerlinEctor
bools.comment: Uther Pendragon died in Arthur's boyhood; Merlin hid the babe with Sir Ector, trained in war by Ector and in kingliness by Merlin

bools.name: dgcArthurRoundTable
bools.comment: Arthur married his lady Gwynevere and organized the Knights of the Round Table to fight for all that is right and proper

bools.name: dgcArthurLawfulRighteousness
bools.comment: Arthur upholds the idea of lawful righteousness and fair play

bools.name: dgcExcaliburSharpness
bools.comment: he wields the sword Excalibur, a lawful good sword of sharpness

bools.name: dgcScabbardPreventsCutting
bools.comment: the scabbard prevents him from being cut by any attack

bools.name: dgcArthurHalfDamageDoctrine
bools.comment: thrusting and slashing attacks against Arthur do half damage (from the force of the blow); bludgeoning attacks do full damage

bools.name: dgcArthurGoldDragonShield
bools.comment: his shield device is a gold dragon

bools.name: dgcBernladGreenArmor
bools.comment: as long as he wears his bright green armor, Bernlad cannot be hurt by physical weapons

bools.name: dgcBernladArmorPersonal
bools.comment: the armor is enchanted for Bernlad only, and is normal plate mail for anyone else

bools.name: dgcBernladNeutralStance
bools.comment: one of the few powerful good knights that would not side with Arthur - though he also would not side with Arthur's enemies

bools.name: dgcBernladBaitsKnights
bools.comment: he was fond of baiting knights of the Round Table to test their courage

bools.name: dgcGalahadWhiteArmor
bools.comment: dressed in white armor

bools.name: dgcGalahadParentage
bools.comment: the bastard son of Sir Launcelot and Princess Elaine

bools.name: dgcGalahadParagon
bools.comment: the perfect representation of knighthood - a paragon of purity and invincibility

bools.name: dgcGalahadHolyGrail
bools.comment: it was he who successfully completed the quest for the Holy Grail

bools.name: dgcGarethSonOfLot
bools.comment: the young son of King Lot, Gareth served in the kitchens of King Arthur

bools.name: dgcGarethEnemyOfKay
bools.comment: he became the enemy of Sir Kay, who called him Beaumains

bools.name: dgcGarethModest
bools.comment: he was the most modest of all the knights

bools.name: dgcGarethHelpsLadies
bools.comment: he used his great fighting skills to help many a lady in distress, especially one Lady Lyoness

bools.name: dgcGarethManyColors
bools.comment: noted for the many colors he used on his armor and shield

bools.name: dgcGarlonFightsInvisibly
bools.comment: this knight would always fight invisibly

bools.name: dgcGarlonDefeatedByConcert
bools.comment: only defeated by the combined might of several knights of quality acting in concert

bools.name: dgcGarlonWitchOfTheFens
bools.comment: given the power of invisibility by a witch of the fens

bools.name: dgcGarlonPowerForEvil
bools.comment: he promised the witch to only use the power for evil

bools.name: dgcGawaineMagicalGift
bools.comment: Gawaine has been given a magical gift of an unusual nature: from 9 in the morning till 12 noon he gains in strength

bools.name: dgcGawaineStrengthReturns
bools.comment: after 12 his strength returns to normal (the armor move of 6 is at normal strength)

bools.name: dgcGawaineFavoriteCousin
bools.comment: the favorite cousin of King Arthur

bools.name: dgcGawaineRevengeful
bools.comment: a revengeful knight who would travel to the ends of the earth to right some supposed wrong done to him or his family

bools.name: dgcLamorakSonOfPellinore
bools.comment: the son of King Pellinore

bools.name: dgcLamorakTournamentChampion
bools.comment: a constant champion at many tournaments held by Queen Margawse, Lamorak's lover

bools.name: dgcLamorakKilledTable
bools.comment: this knight was the death of several members of the Round Table

bools.name: dgcLamorakEnemyOfGawaine
bools.comment: his greatest enemy was Sir Gawaine and his brothers

bools.name: dgcLamorakKilledTwelve
bools.comment: noted for a battle in which he killed 12 renegade knights of Morgan le Fay

bools.name: dgcLauncelotBestOfBest
bools.comment: the best of the best in the circle of the Round Table

bools.name: dgcLauncelotFellFromGrace
bools.comment: able to use all the powers of a Paladin, until he fell from grace by being tricked into loving King Pelles' daughter, the lovely Elaine

bools.name: dgcLauncelotGalahadSon
bools.comment: Elaine bore him a son, the knight Sir Galahad

bools.name: dgcLauncelotLeftTheKing
bools.comment: forced to leave the side of King Arthur, who had treated Launcelot as the king's champion

bools.name: dgcLauncelotNeverFails
bools.comment: he would never fail to aid the king in time of need

bools.name: dgcLauncelotQuests
bools.comment: he went on all of the most important quests for the king and his weapons skills defended the King's side in major battles

bools.name: dgcMerlinParentage
bools.comment: the son of a sorceress and an incubus (a succubus shape-changed into male form)

bools.name: dgcMerlinPowersBeyondMortals
bools.comment: Merlin has a combination of powers and abilities far beyond those of mortals

bools.name: dgcMerlinGreatDruid
bools.comment: a great deal of evidence supports the concept that Merlin is a being as powerful as the Great Druid with magical powers thrown in

bools.name: dgcMerlinNoArmorOrWeapons
bools.comment: he never uses armor or normal physical weapons

bools.name: dgcMerlinStaffSpellStorings
bools.comment: his staff is as a staff of many spell storings and acts as a staff of striking

bools.name: dgcMerlinAbsorbsSpells
bools.comment: with this device Merlin can absorb spells thrown at him and turn the power into spells of his own needs (like a staff of the magi)

bools.name: dgcMerlinForeseesRandomly
bools.comment: Merlin can foresee the future in a random manner; his inability to see just ahead causes him great problems

bools.name: dgcMerlinTeleportsFromDanger
bools.comment: he always teleports away from danger that could cause him a quick death

bools.name: dgcMerlinSurvivedMortalDamage
bools.comment: on several occasions he was attacked and suffered damage that would kill a mortal man

bools.name: dgcMerlinHealsMagically
bools.comment: his magical skills allow him to heal the remainder (beyond the regeneration)

bools.name: dgcMerlinEarthy
bools.comment: a very earthy being - a pretty face may cause him to act rather boyish in order to impress a lady

bools.name: dgcMerlinAttackModesBCE
bools.comment: the printed attack/defense modes: attack B, C, E

bools.name: dgcMerlinAllDefenses
bools.comment: the printed defense modes: All

bools.name: dgcMorganHalfSister
bools.comment: the half sister to King Arthur

bools.name: dgcMorganIllusionQueen
bools.comment: this sorceress constantly uses the powers of illusion to attempt to become queen of the British Isles

bools.name: dgcMorganBloodTie
bools.comment: Arthur was aware of her evil but never acted openly against her because of their blood tie

bools.name: dgcMorganPartiallyNonhuman
bools.comment: as her name indicates (Fay = Faerie), Morgan is at least partially nonhuman

bools.name: dgcMorganTricksKnights
bools.comment: sometimes able to trick knights of the Round Table into her castle

bools.name: dgcMorganSeduceOrImprison
bools.comment: she will either seduce them to evil ways or imprison them for a time

bools.name: dgcMorganPoisonedDagger
bools.comment: her special attack: poisoned dagger

bools.name: dgcPalomidesRivalOfTristram
bools.comment: a bitter rival of Sir Tristram

bools.name: dgcPalomidesScimitar
bools.comment: noted for the quickness of his scimitar and his courage in battle

bools.name: dgcPalomidesCompositeBow
bools.comment: noted for his use of the composite bow - a weapon not usually used by knights of any order

bools.name: dgcPellinoreFoughtArthur
bools.comment: this knight fought with King Arthur and almost defeated him

bools.name: dgcPellinoreRoundTable
bools.comment: he later joined the Round Table and became one of the Queen's Guards

bools.name: dgcPellinoreQuestingBeast
bools.comment: Pellinore hunts a strange unique creature, the Questing Beast

bools.name: dgcPellinoreFatedPursuit
bools.comment: his family is fated to pursue it, though neither they nor anybody else will ever catch it

bools.name: dgcPellinorePastMiddleAge
bools.comment: at the time of Arthur's court, Pellinore is just past middle age, though still a stout fighter

bools.name: dgcTristramSecondBest
bools.comment: known for his skill of arms and savagery in battle, considered by many second only to Launcelot in battle skills

bools.name: dgcTristramIsolde
bools.comment: well-known for his ill-fated romance with the beautiful Lady Isolde, who is married to the evil and cowardly King Mark

bools.name: dgcTristramMarkJealous
bools.comment: the insanely jealous King searches constantly for ways to discredit or destroy the noble Tristram
